The evidence concerns the software platform **Ocelot** at the domain **ocelotbot.com**.

### Vendor / Operating Company
The vendor directly providing Ocelot is **CareerAmerica, LLC** (operating as **Ocelot**).

### Provider Statement
According to the Terms of Use hosted on `ocelotbot.com`:
> *"OCELOT is a service of CareerAmerica, LLC. The purpose of this website is to describe the products and services offered by OCELOT. The terms and conditions set forth herein (the “Terms of Use”) constitute a legally binding agreement between OCELOT and you regarding the terms on which OCELOT offers you access to its Website."*
